text:
alisha: Quick check-in on the thin-slab unbundle plan — target is to carve out the routing + tenant-mapping hotpath over the next 3 quarters. Goal: shrink blast radius of runtime changes and make per-tenant quotas enforceable without touching the core session store.
mei: +1. We should lock the contract for the routing API first. If it changes later we risk repeating work.
pat: Can someone paste the minimal interface we want to freeze? Execs asked for a clear rollback story.
sanjay: Proposal (super tiny):
```
POST /v1/route
{ tenant_id, session_id, model_hint, priority }
returns 200 { route_id, backend, shard_hint }
```
This keeps routing pure and lets runtime own kv/cache.
alisha: I like that. Also: ownership ledger — a single doc listing which team owns each control plane decision (routing, session lifecycle, quota, fallback policies). We'll use that to gate changes.
mei: For paydown, propose 2-week debt sprints: one sprint to extract the adapter, next sprint to flip traffic with a canary, then one to tear down old hooks. Keep the canary small (1-2% traffic).
pat: How do we measure regressions? SLOs + token-cost deltas?
sanjay: SLOs (p95 latency on hotpath), error rate, and per-token median cost. We'll add a perf test suite that runs in CI and a small shadow traffic harness in staging.
deploy-bot: Deploy scheduled: routing-adapter-spike -> staging at 2024-06-12T15:00Z, canary window 4h.
mei: One more nit: kv ownership. Runtime team retains the physical store, but adapter exposes only ephemeral keys and a lease protocol. That avoids migrations of persistent sessions.
alisha: Important: add a compatibility shim for old clients for 6 months. We'll accept 2x operational complexity while rollouts happen. Document in ownership ledger.
sanjay: Rollback plan: flip canary to 0%, roll traffic back to original route service, and run a compacting job to reconcile any partial leases. Script in ops repo: `scripts/rollback_unbundle.sh`.
pat: Can we add a small doc with migration checklist? I'll draft and share.
mei: I'll put the API contract + sample interactions in the repo under `design/routing-unbundle.md`.
alisha: OK — next steps: Mei to PR API contract, Sanjay to sketch CI perf harness, Pat to draft migration checklist, I'll create the ownership ledger and link it to the RFC. Checkin in 48h. :thumbsup:
pat: ack
sanjay: ack
mei: ack
deploy-bot: Reminder: staging deploy will post updates to #eng-releases when it starts.
